name: Responsible-gambling / 18+ disclaimer is present on the Odds surface
description: Any product surfacing betting odds must show a responsible-gambling notice (an 18+/21+ age statement, 'odds for informational purposes', or a help-line / 'gamble responsibly' message). A real betting brief that omits this is non-compliant; a placeholder or absent disclaimer fails.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage and open a match detail page
Click the Betting Odds tab and read any surrounding notices, footnotes, or disclaimers on the odds surface

Verify a responsible-gambling or age-restriction disclaimer is visibly present on or adjacent to the Odds tab — for example an '18+' / '21+' notice, a 'gamble responsibly' message, a help-line reference, or an 'odds shown for informational purposes only' statement. No such notice anywhere on the odds surface fails this test.
